props.name: reference
props.comment: The resource that holds the comments.

props.name: target
props.comment: The field of a comment that holds the id of the record it belongs to.

props.name: resolvable
props.comment: Show a Mark resolved button on unresolved comments. Default `false`.

props.name: perPage
props.comment: How many comments to fetch. Default `100`.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to comment on; defaults to the ambient record.
